adminLevel.description: Configure simplify tolerance by admin level. Admin 1+ can reference values from the previous tab.

geojson.caption: GeoJSON path checks triangle-shape drift using edge length against polygon BBox span.

buildRunning.title: Build is running
buildRunning.body: A build session is currently running. Open the Build step to view progress.

download.title: Source stage settings
download.workersHelp: Controls how many source tasks run in parallel.
download.deleteApiCacheHelp: API cache: fetched raw data for this node (before filtering).
download.deleteFilteredCacheHelp: Filtered cache: source-stage filtered feature collections per zoom band.
download.deleteGeometryHelp: Simplified cache: simplified geometries by zoom band plus Geometry error records.
download.deleteTileEmitHelp: Tile data: generated vector tiles (tile index is also cleared).
download.deleteMetadataHelp: Feature metadata for search/preview (does not remove tiles).
download.timeoutHelp: Maximum time to wait for each source request before failing.
download.retryAttemptsHelp: Number of retries per failed source request.
download.retryDelayHelp: Wait time between retry attempts when a source request fails.

urlRules.title: URL specific build config rules
urlRules.description: Define per-URL overrides in JSON. This JSON is evaluated in order and each entry applies to matching URLs.

extract1.title: Geometry (Filtering)
extract1.omissionHelp: Small polygons may be excluded based on the polygon area coefficient and feature filtering.

extract2.title: Geometry (Tile Preprocessing)
extract2.omissionHelp: When enabled, preprocessing can remove empty geometries.
extract2.extractionModeHelp: Choose how geometry is prepared during tile preprocessing.

filter.title: Geometry Settings
filter.workersStage1Help: Higher concurrency can speed up processing but may exhaust browser memory.
filter.workersStage2Help: Higher concurrency can speed up processing but may exhaust browser memory.
filter.areaFilterHelp: Applied during geometry filtering (feature filtering and aspect/area checks).
filter.methodHelp: Selects how small features are filtered before geometry.
filter.minimumAreaHelp: Filters out features smaller than this area during geometry filtering.
filter.aspectRatioThresholdHelp: Filters elongated features during geometry when their aspect ratio exceeds this value.
filter.areaThresholdHelp: Minimum area used with the geometry aspect ratio filter.
filter.excludePolygonAreaCoefficientHelp: Excludes polygons smaller than coefficient × grid size × outline length / 2 in source filtering.
filter.omitDetailsLevelWeakHelp: Keeps large, medium, and small islands.
filter.toleranceHelp: Higher values straighten boundaries and remove fine details. Small or thin features are more likely to be filtered out in combination with the filters. Downstream (Geometry preprocessing and TileEmit) becomes lighter and smaller, but geometric fidelity decreases.
filter.toleranceHelpStage2: Applies Geometry preprocessing for tile emission.
filter.minVertexCountHelp: Only apply geometry area filtering when feature vertices exceed this count.
filter.quickRejectHelp: Lower values reject more tiny features quickly.
filter.simpleShapeVertexHelp: Vertex count threshold for simple-shape handling.
filter.elongatedShapeHelp: Correction factor for elongated simple shapes.
filter.regularShapeMinRatioHelp: Minimum ratio considered a regular-shaped feature.
filter.regularShapeMaxRatioHelp: Maximum ratio considered a regular-shaped feature.
filter.enablePerFeatureExtraction: Allow geometry to omit countries or municipalities
filter.enablePerFeatureExtractionHelp: Geometries may be omitted, but metadata is retained.
filter.boundaryDisableAtZoomOrAbove: Disable boundary handling at zoom or above
filter.boundaryDisableAtZoomOrAboveHelp: Stops boundary preservation above this zoom.
filter.zoomBandRangesHelp: Configure zoom band boundaries and range counts.
filter.zoomBandRangeCountHelp: Controls how many zoom ranges are grouped into bands.
filter.zoomBandBoundariesHelp: Adjust the zoom boundaries between ranges.

cache.title: Cache management
cache.descriptionTooltip: Controls build output retention and cleanup behavior by stage.

tile.title: TileEmit
tile.descriptionTooltip: Emit vector tiles for the selected zoom range.
tile.workersHelp: Concurrent workers for TileEmit. Dynamic TileEmit concurrency requires 2+.
tile.extentHelp: Controls the resolution of tile coordinates.
tile.tileSizeHelp: Base tile size used for extent calculations.
tile.toleranceHelp: Simplification tolerance applied during tile generation.
tile.layerSetNameHelp: Name of the output layer group.
tile.promoteIdHelp: Property name used to promote feature IDs.
tile.indexMaxPointsHelp: Maximum number of points per tile in the initial index.
tile.inputFormatHelp: Input data format for tile generation.
tile.outputCompressionHelp: Compression applied to vector tile output.
tile.boundaryDedupeHelp: Remove duplicate boundary lines to reduce tile size.
tile.bufferHelp: Tile buffer on each side in px.
tile.zoomBandsSummary: Zoom bands follow the Geometry range boundaries. The representative zoom is the smallest in each band.
tile.expandFactorHelp: Expand tile groups when assembling TopoJSON buffers.
tile.expandMarginHelp: Extra margin (in tiles) for neighbor selection.
tile.dynamicConcurrencyHelp: Adjusts TileEmit worker counts based on runtime load.
tile.tileCountThresholdHelp: Stops tile generation once the tile count exceeds this value.
tile.zoomLevelsHelp: Zoom levels to generate tiles for.

preview.description: Visualize generated vector tiles on the map.
preview.noTiles: No vector tiles are available yet. Run the build to generate tiles.
preview.waiting: Vector tiles are being prepared. The map will appear once tiles are ready.
